bullets.title: SHOP: Jefferies upgrades to Buy, PT $160 on GMV data + 2027 price increase thesis
bullets.body: Jefferies (Samad) upgrades SHOP to Buy—first buy rating since Jan 2023—raising PT to $160 (from $140, 31% upside). Shop.App subdomain traffic and 3P data suggest material Q2 GMV beat; partner-program changes should lower S&M costs; analyst sees a ~3-4% revenue tailwind from a 2027 price increase similar to the 2023 non-Plus hike. Stock was trading +3% in premarket.

bullets.title: TSM: Record Q2 revenue +36% YoY; likely to raise 2026 capex guide to ~$60B; 1.4nm ahead of schedule
bullets.body: TSMC reported Q2 NT$1.27T (+36% YoY, top of guidance), with June alone up 67.9% YoY to an all-time-high NT$442.68B. H1 revenues +35.6% YoY. Street expects management to raise 2026 USD sales guidance to +44% and capex toward $60B; 2nm/3nm wafer targets of 350-400K/month. Separately, the 1.4nm fab is ahead of schedule with first production by April 2027, mass production mid-2028. TSMC also plans 3 more advanced packaging plants in Chiayi.

bullets.title: Memory sector selloff: SK Hynix IPO sell-the-news + CEO warns 2027 worst supply year; SNDK/WDC/MU -4-5%
bullets.body: SK Hynix's $26.5B Nasdaq debut (largest foreign US IPO ever) sparked a 'sell-the-news' reaction; Korean ADR fell ~10-16% overnight after +15% debut. CEO warned 2027 will be worst year in industry history from a supply perspective and that demand will exceed supply capacity into the next decade. US-listed memory names hit hard premarket: SNDK -5.3%, WDC -5.0%, MU -4.4%, STX -4.2%. Goldman raises SNDK PT to $3,100 citing three new long-term business model agreements (~$42B RPO).

bullets.title: META: $50B Louisiana datacenter, 14GW compute by 2027, Muse Spark 1.1 praised; stock +15-20% in July
bullets.body: META announced expansion of Louisiana datacenter to 5GW compute with $50B+ total regional investment; separately reaffirmed plans for 14GW total compute by 2027. Muse Spark 1.1 launched as first external AI API (priced ~25% of Anthropic/OpenAI) driving significant investor sentiment shift. JPM remains Neutral ($725 PT) wanting more evidence of enterprise adoption before upgrading. MS upgrades to OW with $775 PT. Q2 revenue expectations ~$61.5B (+29.5% YoY); 2027 capex guide expected $200-225B range.

bullets.title: GOOGL: Cloud expected +70-75% YoY Q2 with $500B+ backlog; Gemini losing AI benchmark leadership
bullets.body: JPM flags GOOGL Cloud revenue consensus too low (+64% vs buy-side estimate +70-75% for Q2), with backlog expected $500B+ (vs $462B last quarter). However, Gemini is losing luster vs OpenAI, Anthropic, and META on LLM rankings. MS raises hyperscaler capex estimates: GOOGL 2027 capex now $325-350B (vs Street ~$250B). 2027 EPS investor range $15.50-16.00.

bullets.title: NVDA/AVGO: UAE AI chip export controls loosened; CRDO/NVDA flagged as frontier-model capex beneficiaries
bullets.body: US expanded UAE access to Nvidia AI chips and defense equipment, a new export market. Multiple desks flag NVDA and CRDO as top beneficiaries of frontier-model competition (META, SpaceX/xAI concentrated on NVDA GPUs). MS upgrades scale-up network TAM to ~$70B by 2030 (4x prior). AVGO benefits from confirmed $30B+ multiyear AAPL chip deal. Citi maintains NVDA PT $300, AVGO PT $500; AMD #1 pick on agentic CPU demand.

bullets.title: INTC: 18A execution concerns send stock -8.8%; UBS raises PT to $121 on DCAI beat-and-raise outlook
bullets.body: Reports of Intel 18A delays sent INTC down 8.8% on the week. Trump administration's support cited as critical to Intel's resurgence. UBS raises PT from $83 to $121 expecting a beat-and-raise on Q2 DCAI/server CPU pricing; models Jun Q revenue $15.3B vs prior $14.8B, Sep Q $16.4B. AAPL secured semiconductor tariff exemption in exchange for committing to manufacture both Mac and iPhone chips at Intel fabs.

bullets.title: NFLX: Multiple desks cut PT to ~$92-100 but maintain Outperform; engagement concerns into Thu earnings
bullets.body: KeyBanc cuts PT to $92 (from $115), OPCO/Wolfe to $100, maintaining Outperform. Engagement concerns: limited original content in H1, TF1 France partnership hit 18-month targets in 3 weeks (upside read). Survey data shows 5x more subscribers increased viewing vs decreased; churn fears 'overblown.' Ad CPM ~$6 vs peer ~$15 implies multi-billion dollar upside. Q2 EPS consensus $0.79, revenue $12.58B; reports Thursday AH.

bullets.title: AAPL: Citi raises PT to $365, Buy; sues OpenAI for trade secrets; tariff exemption on semis for Intel chip commitment
bullets.body: Citi raises AAPL to $365 (Buy) on margin resilience from price increases and Apple Intelligence. Separately, Apple filed a civil lawsuit against OpenAI alleging trade secret theft by former employees Tang Tan and Chang Liu (400 Apple hires total at OpenAI). AAPL accelerating M7 chip roadmap (skipping M6 variants), with M7 Ultra expected 2028. Tariff exemption from semiconductor duties secured in exchange for Intel fab commitment.

bullets.title: FOXA: Wolfe upgrades to Outperform, $71 PT on Roku synergies and Tubi >$2B revenue path
bullets.body: Peter Supino upgrades FOXA to Outperform with $71 PT (32% upside vs $54). The FOXA/ROKU combination creates a high-value CTV ecosystem; synergies ~$400M, Tubi projected $2B+ revenue by 2028, and pro forma revenue growth ~6% annually to 2030 vs implied ~3%. PT based on 13x FY27/FY28 UFCF.

bullets.title: DIS: Benchmark initiates Buy at $115; Moana opens $43M (below $60M target), Toy Story 5 at $403M cumulative
bullets.body: Benchmark initiates DIS at Buy with $115 PT (~20% upside from $95.62). Weekend box office revenues fell 38.8% YoY to $123M total; Moana opened $43M vs $60M target. Toy Story 5 earned $18.5M weekend and $403.8M cumulative. NFLX reports Thursday; Wolfe rates DIS Outperform with $131 PT (+35.5%).

bullets.title: WBD/PSKY merger: Oregon AG drops objection; PSKY mulling HQ move out of California
bullets.body: Oregon AG withdrew motion to delay WBD-PSKY merger, though California AG (backed by NY/WA/CT) still expected to file suit this week. PSKY is considering relocating headquarters outside California and reallocating much of $30B in planned spending, with CEO David Ellison reportedly supportive of the move.

bullets.title: Goldman raises CDNS/SNPS to Buy on $3.7B Agentic AI EDA revenue opportunity; initiates PRAX Buy
bullets.body: Goldman initiates PRAX Buy ($447 PT) on ulixacaltamide in essential tremor (Jan 2027 PDUFA, ~95% PoS, $10B+ market). Raises CDNS PT to $470 and reiterates SNPS Buy on $3.7B incremental Agentic AI revenue opportunity from custom silicon through AI copilots/autonomous agents (monetization starting 2H26). Also raises SPGI revenue growth estimate to +15.2% YoY and MCO to +15.4%.

bullets.title: CRM: Procurement survey flags elevated renewal scrutiny and shelfware; MSFT/NOW best positioned for AI monetization
bullets.body: UBS ProcureCon survey: AI and cybersecurity most resilient spend categories. CRM faces elevated renewal scrutiny and resistance to incremental spend ('double dipping' fears on seat+usage pricing); flagged for elevated shelfware. MSFT and NOW viewed as best positioned to monetize AI via seat+usage pricing due to cost savings, workflow embedding, and daily engagement.

bullets.title: TXN/INTC: UBS expects beat-and-raise; TXN Q3 guide ~$5.9B well above Street consensus ~$5.5-5.6B
bullets.body: UBS reiterated TXN Buy ($350 PT) expecting Jun-Q toward/above guidance high on data center +90% YoY and industrial/auto strength; Q3 guide expected ~$5.9B (10% QoQ vs normal 5-7%). INTC PT raised $83→$121 on DCAI/server CPU pricing power and higher gross margin outlook (low 40%s vs 39% guidance). STX PT raised $545→$860 Neutral; WDC PT raised $375→$560 Neutral.

bullets.title: AVGO/AAPL $30B chip deal mostly priced in per UBS; China H200 approval capacity-constrained not demand-limited
bullets.body: UBS says AVGO/AAPL $30B multi-year deal already modeled: ~$0.5B C2026, $5.6B C2027, $17.5B C2028. China may approve limited H200 purchases (~200K GPUs) but NVDA's CoWoS-S advanced packaging is the true bottleneck. Broadcom's 'Iris' chip for META completed prototype in 6 months.

bullets.title: GLW/COHR/LITE/FN: JPM builds positive sentiment; MS identifies as clearest optical beneficiaries with OCP event in October
bullets.body: JPM notes CLS, LITE, FN all attracting constructive investor tone amid recent pullback and 2H26 catalysts; ANET drawing unease despite growing optimism; GLW carrying negative tilt on valuation. MS identifies LITE, COHR, GLW as clearest scale-up optical beneficiaries with co-packaged optics adoption accelerating from 2029+; OCP event in October seen as next catalyst. Wolfe rates LITE/FN/CIEN Outperform with significant upside.

bullets.title: DKNG: Iowa sports betting GGR -22% YoY on unfavorable hold; JPM rates OW with $31 PT
bullets.body: Iowa June sports betting GGR was -15% YoY industry-wide with handle +10% but hold rate at 8.9% (-260bps YoY). DKNG specifically -22% YoY GGR with handle +23% but hold rate 8.2% (-480bps). JPM gaming/lodging table rates DKNG Overweight with $31 PT (17% upside from $26.48).

bullets.title: VST/CEG/TLN: Goldman raises US power demand CAGR to 3.5%; PJM largest DC market; AI power complex underperforming tech bounce
bullets.body: Goldman raises US power demand CAGR to 3.2%→3.5% through 2030, driven by data center electricity needs (108GW/947TWh by 2030, 23% CAGR). PJM remains largest DC market; MISO surpasses ERCOT as #2 by 2030. JPM/Wells flags AI Power complex (VST, CEG, TLN, WULF, HUT) saw <5% recovery vs tech hardware's ~30% rebound after the steep July 1 drawdown.

bullets.title: IONQ/CRWV/NBIS: Roth QSG surveys upcoming; CRWV survey in progress; macro week ahead heavy
bullets.body: Key data this week: CPI Tuesday, PPI Wednesday, retail sales Thursday, Fed Chair Warsh semiannual testimony. Roth QSG has upcoming surveys planned for CRWV (CoreWeave) and digital advertising trends. Q2 S&P 500 EPS growth estimated at 23.3% (revised to 29%+ based on historical patterns); semiconductor sector expected to account for ~50% of total S&P 500 earnings growth.
